description: Get the link to a free "new manager assimilation" (new leader integration) for a manager who has just taken over a team: the team answers the classic questions anonymously on a link (what we know, what we want to know, our concerns, what we need, how we can help); AI groups the answers into themes and rewords answers that could identify their author; the manager prepares privately, then answers the team in a meeting with a screen mode and records next steps. Optional HR or coach facilitator. No sign-up. Best 4 to 8 weeks after the manager starts.

language.description: en, fr, de or es; default en

name: start_new_manager_assimilation
title: Start a new manager assimilation
